V1.explanation: the first step of the mask sequence is the only position where the two arms provably received the same legal list; after a fork the partial plans differ and the legal lists may legitimately differ
V1.post_fork_legal_not_compared: after the first divergence the arms run different partial plans, so their subsequent legal lists are allowed to differ; this is a consequence of the policies, not an input identity mismatch

audit.single_factor_note: both arms were given the SAME state object; the only declared difference is scorer_id
